name: uagents
description: CLI-first persistent Agent dispatch with managed desktop lifecycle, optional MCP access and explicit model routing.

interface.shortDescription: Call different Agents through one tracked protocol.
interface.longDescription: CLI-first task protocol with optional MCP access for agy, WorkBuddy, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, Doubao Work and TRAE CN. Discovers and verifies local installations, drives DeepSeek Harness through its official SDK stdio JSON-RPC profile, auto-starts Doubao Work and TRAE CN in dedicated isolated profiles across tasks, resumes first-login waits on the original attempt, and tracks idempotency, native identity, model resolution, send ambiguity, cancellation intent and verified artifacts. It never signs in, approves dialogs, buys quota or touches the user's own windows.
defaultPrompt: 选择适合的已接入 Agent，委派任务并检查结果。
